title: CLARA Care Connected Health & Wearables — Sync Adapter Protocol Contract

endpoints.summary: Handshake & capability discovery for mobile and cloud wearable sync adapters
Synchronize batch of canonical health records with idempotency, rate limiting, and safe error envelopes

headers.name: X-Idempotency-Key
headers.description: Optional HTTP header override for batch idempotency deduplication key

endpoints.summary: Body-addressed batch synchronization endpoint for sync adapter clients
Query current sync cursor, watermark, and pending record state
Acknowledge cursor commitment by the adapter client

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: Sync rate exceeded sliding window limit (60 req/min). Returns Retry-After header.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: Batch exceeds 500 records or 5MB payload size limit (payload bomb guard).

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.description: Idempotency key was reused with differing record payload.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH.description: X-Idempotency-Key header does not match body payload idempotency_key.

CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.description: Connector ID does not exist or is not owned by the requesting user.

CONNECTOR_NOT_READY.description: Connector is not in connected or healthy status (e.g. paused or disconnected).

SCOPE_MISMATCH.description: Batch profile_id or connector_id does not match authenticated connector scope.

PROVIDER_MISMATCH.description: Provider string does not match connector account provider.

CONSENT_REVOKED.description: User has revoked data processing consent for this connector.

INVALID_PAYLOAD.description: Record values, units, or temporal intervals violate schema semantics.

INVALID_CONNECTOR_ID.description: Connector ID format is not a valid integer.

vietnamese_pdpd_decree_13_2023.article_9_data_minimization: Direct identifiers, tokens, and hardware serials are omitted from sync DTOs and audit logs.
vietnamese_pdpd_decree_13_2023.article_11_consent: Consent check is enforced on every sync batch prior to database persistence.
vietnamese_pdpd_decree_13_2023.article_12_withdrawal: Consent revocation terminates adapter ingestion immediately with HTTP 403 CONSENT_REVOKED.

law_on_medical_examination_15_2023_qh15.article_65_electronic_health_records: Standardized canonical observations retain immutable origin, timestamps, and recording method.
